_meta.description: Hand-crafted starter evaluation set for English intent classification. NOT extracted from real customer traffic — no real store has been onboarded yet. Built to establish a first English-only baseline before evaluating bilingual Arabic/English performance.
_meta.label_source: hand-labeled by the developer, one label per example
_meta.note: This is a small starter set with 5 examples per intent (n=40). It is a baseline, not a statistically rigorous benchmark. A future bilingual evaluation set should be added separately.
